items.proposed: 1p/19q codeletion: eligibility (exclusion), candidate_matched false; no effect on outcomes
items.reason: 'Patients with oligodendroglioma, IDH-mutant and 1p/19q-codeleted are not eligible' is a diagnostic exclusion, not candidate-matched; selection outcomes are already set by the IDH1-mutation requirement matched to olutasidenib.

note: Trial fails S5 (IDH1-mutant tumours only; glioblastoma not named). cns5_terminology (priority 3) set to unclear: 'CNS WHO Grade' notation but no explicit WHO 2021 citation or IDH-wildtype requirement.
